spans.s: कुणप् tad. affix कुण added to words of पीलु group in the sense of 'ripen- ed condition';e.g.पीलुकुणः=पीलूनां पाकः; cf.

कुणरवाडव name of an ancient gran- marian who lived possibly after Pāṇini and before Patañjali and who is referred to in the Mahā- bhāṣya as giving an alternative forms for the standard form of cer- tain words; cf. कुणरवाडवस्त्वाह नैषां शंकरा शंगरैषा M.Bh. on
; cf also कुणरवस्त्वाह नैष वहीनरः । कस्तर्हि । विहीनर एषः M. Bh. on
कुणि name of an ancient Vṛttikāra the Sūtras of Pāṇini, mentioned in their works by Kaiyata and Hara- datta; cf. Kaiyaṭa's Pradīpa on
